record.hypothesis: Across all four categories, replace tied unit normalization with e/sqrt(max(||e||2,1e-8)), preserving zero padding (embedding direction). Jointly set Adam LR=0.0005, dropout=0.05 and batch size=256 (hyperparameter direction). Partial normalization retains item-specific magnitude while moderating raw scale; lower dropout preserves weaker recurrent inputs, and larger batches with smaller steps may stabilize their optimization. Retain the incumbent mixed loss, GRU topology, width and history window.

category_rationales.rationale: Across all four category models, jointly lower Adam learning rate to 0.0005, reduce dropout to 0.05 and increase batch size to 256. Smaller steps and larger batches may stabilize optimization with partially normalized embeddings, while lower dropout preserves recurrent input signals. Retain width, history length, GRU topology and training caps.

Replace tied unit normalization with e/sqrt(max(||e||_2,1e-8)) across history, target and candidate lookups. Partial normalization retains item-specific magnitude while moderating scale and preserving zero padding. The generated predictor imports this class from train.py, so inference uses the same transformation without checkpoint shape changes.
